name: browser-profile-contract
goal: Accept real browser navigation and heap observations for their declared unit target without accepting stale, mismatched or fixture evidence.

evidence: The current collector produces real browser-navigation-ms and browser-js-heap-bytes observations, but PerformanceEvidenceValidator recognizes neither. Actual retained catalog navigation data is rejected. The collector also labels module-backed Svelte pages as HTTP; that separate test-workflow binding will be corrected without rewriting archived captures.

The standard performance-evidence matrix covers latency-prefixed timing and process RSS, but omits existing browser metric names. Extend it with declared module and HTTP targets and wrong-target rejection. The root cause is the mandatory validator introduced without exercising the real browser producer protocol.

Sealed red at 0baf335c3 fails both declared-target browser cases with the named navigation/heap assertion; 20 existing cases pass. The first attempt lacked snapshot dependencies and was rejected as setup failure; only the locked-install rerun is defect proof.

Recognize the two existing browser metric names alongside canonical latency and memory observations. Preserve revision, profile, callable, workload, sample and declared-target matching, including fixture exclusion. Correct the producer module binding separately and rerun its actual browser flow; do not relabel archived measurements.
